name: Firewall
description: Firewall and autonomous defence agent: analyses traffic in real time, recognises attacks, shows where they come from and protects the home with reversible responses
capabilities: Real-time analysis of ethernet and wifi traffic (Rust engine)
Detection of scans, brute force, floods, ARP spoofing, DNS tunnels and exfiltration
Lockdown: access only for authorised IPs, networks and MACs
Expert rules with groups, ports, rate limits and expiry
AI analyst proposing countermeasures to approve
Confirmation within 90 seconds with automatic rollback
Autonomous defence agent: groups alerts into incidents, recognises the kind of attack and picks the response (Rust engine)
Country of origin of attacks from a local database: no address is ever sent to outside services
Three autonomy levels (observe, assist, autonomous) with hourly limits and safeguards so you are never locked out
